Panchen Lama - entertained by local Kuomintang

The Panchen Lama and his followers were entertained to dinner by the local Kuomintang at the Reception Office of the City Government at 1881 Avenue Joffre, between 7 p.m. and 9 p.m. May 29.

Local Machine Made Ice Traders - dispute with the Yah Zung Company settled

In connection with the dispute between the local made ice traders and the Yah Zung Company (Vide I.R. 27/4/34), a meeting was held in the local Kuomintang Headquarters, Feng Ling Chiao, New Western District at 11 a.m. May 29 when representatives of the traders and the Company signed an agreement containing the following conditions :-

1. That the price per ton be fixed as follows :-
From January to April $7.00
" May to June $12.00
" July to September $16.00
" October to December $10.00

2. That an extra fee of $1.00 per ton be charged if the ice be delivered to traders by coolies of the Company.

3. That the Company be fined $1,000.00 should it sell ice at a figure below the price fixed.

4. That all traders deposit a guarantee in the sum of $200.00 and that all accounts be settled at the end of each month.

5月30日，

政治类 (2)

班禅喇嘛 – 受当地国民党款待

5月29日晚7时至9时，班禅喇嘛及其随从在霞飞路1881号市政府接待处接受了当地国民党的晚宴款待。

本地机制冰商 – 与亚松公司（Yah Zung Company）的纠纷已解决

关于本地制冰商与亚松公司之间的纠纷（参见 34年4月27日情报报告），5月29日上午11时在新西区丰灵桥（Feng Ling Chiao，音译）当地国民党总部举行了一次会议，届时商人代表与公司代表签署了一份协议，包含以下条件：-

1. 每吨价格规定如下：-
一月至四月 7.00元
五月至六月 12.00元
七月至九月 16.00元
十月至十二月 10.00元

2. 若由公司苦力向商人运送冰块，每吨加收1.00元额外费用。

3. 若公司以低于规定价格出售冰块，将被罚款1,000.00元。

4. 所有商人需缴纳200.00元保证金，且所有账目须在每月月底结清。

May 17, 1934. Morning Translation.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

MEETING OF CHINESE RATEPAYERS IN FRENCH CONCESSION.

The Chinese Ratepayers Association of the French Concession, at a meeting held at 3 p.m. yesterday, passed the following resolutions:-
1) That efforts be made to accelerate negotiations for an increase in the number of Chinese Councillors on the French Municipal Council.
2) That at the request of the 2nd Branch Association of the 2nd Special District Citizens Federation, the Association send a letter to the French authorities demanding that the collection of a separate health tax from silver smith shops be abolished.
3) That residents be notified that the awning tax for a single fronted house is $1.50 and mat shed tax will be collected according to the height of the shed. Cases of extortion should be reported to the Association.
4) That with reference to the letter received from the Chung Fah Hospital (中法醫院), No. 181 Avenue Foch, requesting exemption from Municipal tax, another letter be sent to the French Municipal Council on the subject.
5) The Association has received a letter from the 6th Branch Association of the 2nd Special District Citizens Federation stating that the 8-year only son of Chiung Daung Sz (蔣唐氏) was killed by a motor car belonging to the Hu Foong Dyeing & Weaving Factory (和丰染織廠) off Rue Conty and that the mother requested the Traffic Department of the French Police to deal with the case properly, but her request was rejected. The French authorities disregard the lives of the Chinese residents.
It was resolved that the French authorities be requested to file a prosecution against the Hu Foong Dyeing & Weaving Factory.
During the meeting, Zung Tsoh Sung (莊祖松), who presided, read out the second letter recently sent to Mr. Meyrier, the local French Consul-General, requesting the suppression of dog racing and Hai Alai.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

MACHINE MADE ICE TRADERS MAKE APPEAL.

Local machine made ice traders are opposing the monopoly of the ice market by the Yah Chen Company (協成公司). It was recently ascertained that the Company had made grants of $5,280 and $10,000 to the Kwang Nyi (廣義) and the Yah Lung (裕隆) Ice Companies respectively and persuaded them to close down.
Representatives of the machine made ice traders called at the local Tangpu yesterday and submitted the following demands:-
1) That the Kwang Nyi and the Yah Lung Ice Companies be ordered to resume business.
2) That permission be given for the formation of a Machine Made Ice Traders Association.
3) That a date be fixed for a mediation meeting.

1934年5月17日。晨间译文。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

法租界华人纳税会会议。

法租界华人纳税会于昨日下午3时举行的会议上，通过了以下决议：-
1) 努力加速关于增加法公董局华董人数的谈判。
2) 应第二特区市民联合会第二分会的请求，本会致函法国当局，要求取消对银匠铺单独征收卫生税的规定。
3) 通知居民，单开间房屋的遮阳篷税为1.50元，草棚税将根据棚屋高度征收。如有勒索案件，应向本会举报。
4) 关于收到霞飞路181号中法医院来信请求免除市政税一事，就此事项再致函法公董局。
5) 本会收到第二特区市民联合会第六分会来信，称蔣唐氏仅存的8岁独子被康悌路（Rue Conty）附近和丰染織廠的一辆汽车撞死，其母请求法国警察交通部妥善处理此案，但遭拒绝。法国当局无视中国居民的生命安全。
决议要求法国当局对和丰染織廠提起诉讼。
会议期间，主持人莊祖松宣读了最近致法国驻沪总领事梅理耶（Meyrier）先生的第二封信，要求取缔赛狗和回力球。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

机制冰商提出呼吁。

本地机制冰商反对协成公司（Yah Chen Company）垄断冰市。近日查明，该公司分别向廣義公司和裕隆冰公司提供了5,280元和10,000元的资助，并劝诱它们停业。
昨日，机制冰商代表拜访了当地党部，并提出以下要求：-
1) 命令廣義公司和裕隆冰公司恢复营业。
2) 允许成立机制冰商协会。
3) 确定调解会议的日期。

No. D 5857
Date 17 / 5 / 34

Political (2) May 17, 1934.

Local Machine Made Ice Traders - agitation against
Yah Zung Co. continues

Three representatives of the Machine Made Ice
Traders called at the local Kuomintang at 10 a.m. May 16 and
appealed for assistance in opposing the Yah Zung Co. alleged
to have been promoted by Japanese with the object of
monopolizing the local machine made ice trade. The
callers stated that as a preliminary step to the plan,
the Yah Zung Co. had bought over two Chinese ice plants,
the Kong Nyi Co. at 37 Lunghwa Road and the Yah Loong
Co., Connaught Road, thus depriving the traders of an
opportunity to purchase ice from Chinese factories without
going through the Yah Zung Co.. The callers also applied
for permission to organize a traders' association. The
callers left at 12 noon after being promised that they
request would receive full consideration.

French Concession Chinese Ratepayers' Association

In connection with a report from the 6th Branch
of the 2nd Special District Citizens' Federation to the
effect that the Traffic Department of the French Police
was requested by the mother of a Chinese boy who was
knocked down and killed by a motor car on Rue Conty
on April 25 to deal with the case and had refused,
the above Association has decided to urge the French
Authorities to appeal to Court with a view to having
the chauffeur of the car charged.

In the above report the 6th Branch also protests against
the attitude of the French Police who, it alleges, show a
complete disregard for human life.

亚松公司（Yah Zung Co.）

5月16日上午10时，三名机制冰商代表拜访当地国民党部，请求协助反对亚松公司，据称该公司由日本人扶持，旨在垄断本地机制冰贸易。来访者称，作为该计划的初步步骤，亚松公司收买了两家中国冰厂，即龙华路37号的公义公司（Kong Nyi Co.，音译）和康纳特路（Connaught Road，音译）的裕隆公司（Yah Loong Co.，音译），从而剥夺了商人不通过亚松公司而从中国工厂购买冰块的机会。来访者还申请许可组织商人协会。在得到承诺将充分考虑其请求后，来访者于中午12时离开。

法租界华人纳税会

鉴于第二特区市民联合会第六分会报告称，4月25日一名中国男孩在康悌路（Rue Conty）被汽车撞倒身亡，其母请求法国警察交通部处理此案但遭拒绝，上述协会决定敦促法国当局向法院起诉，以便对肇事司机提出指控。

在上述报告中，第六分会还抗议法国警察的态度，指称其完全漠视人命。

At 1.45 p.m. 27/../34 the two complainants in
this case, came to the station and reported the
receipt of two letters of a threatening nature,
(translations attached), at the times and dates
above mentioned.

Enquiries made by the undersigned and P.C. 72
have ascertained that the complainants reporting
the case are partners in the Yah Lung (杨成) Ice
Co., premises situated at 128 Tanbury Road. This
company was recently formed and has not yet offi-
cially opened although some business is apparently
done at the stated address. The remaining seven
men to whom the letter is addressed are also part-
ners in the firm.

As far as can be ascertained, all of these men
were in the ice business on their own behalf prior
to the formation of the Yah Lung Co. when each of
them conducted business on a credit basis. Great
trouble was experienced by them in collecting
accounts due from their customers however, and so
many accounts were left outstanding that they deci-
ded to group together and form a company with the
intention of conducting business on a C.O.D. basis
only. The formation of the company, and the publica-
tion of the manner in which they proposed to conduct
their business has met with great opposition from
their old customers, and from the retail ice dealers
in general, who have made representations to the
chief partners of the firm and to the local

From Nanking
Arrived at 7.30 a.m. April 27:-
Lieu Zen Heng, Minister of Health.

Local Ice Traders - agitate against Yah Zung Co.
Five representatives of the Machine Made Ice
Traders visited the local Kuomintang, the Bureau of
Social Affairs and the Chinese Chamber of Commerce
on April 26 and appealed for assistance in taking
measures against the Yah Zung Co. which is alleged
to have been jointly promoted by treacherous merchants
and Japanese in order to monopolize the local machine
made ice market. At each of these places they were
promised that a careful investigation would be made
into the matter.
The local Machine Made Ice Manufacturers will
entertain local journalists in the Tsing Loong Restaurant,
corner of Thibet and Nanking Roads to tea at 2 p.m.
April 27 with the object of acquainting the press with
the true circumstances surrounding the opposition of
traders towards the Yah Zung Co.
These manufacturers declare that the accusation
brought by the traders against the Yah Zung Co. as
being promoted with Japanese interests is groundless
and that their opposition is due to the fact that they
would have to settle their accounts with the new Company
as the sole agent for local machine made ice manufacturers,

1st Special District Citizens' Federation - Meeting

Seventeen committee members of the 1st Special
District Citizens' Federation held a meeting in their
office, Chinese Chamber of Commerce building, North
Soochow Road, between 2 p.m. and 4.15 p.m. April 26
and passed the following resolutions:

1. That efforts be made to conduct mediation for a
settlement of the dispute over an increase of rent
existing between the landlords and tenants of the
Ning Kong Li (寧康里), North Chekiang Road.

2. That the request of the 2nd Branch for assistance
in the matter of opposition to an order of the
S.M.C. instructing the sandal wood and Longan shops
in the Settlement to take out food-shop licences
be referred to the S.M.C.

3. That in connection with the alleged wounding of a
shop assistant of the Dah Wha Shoe Store on Yangtszepoo
Road by a stray bullet during the practice of the
Japanese marines on April 19, the following steps be
adopted:-

a) That the Chinese Ratepayers' Association and the
Shanghai City Government be requested to lodge a
protest with the Japanese Consulate Authorities.

b) That the S.M.C. be requested to give assurance of the
non-repetition of similar incidents.

c) That local public bodies be requested to concur
with the above.

4. That investigation be made into the report that
certain traitorous merchants are monopolizing the
machine made ice trade.

April 27, 1934. Morning Translation.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

LOCAL MACHINE MADE ICE TRADERS SUBMIT APPEAL.

Nine representatives of local machine made ice traders called at the local Tangpu and the Bureau of Social Affairs yesterday and demanded that steps be taken to check the activities of the Yah Chen Company (協成公司).
Officials of the authorities promised to make enquiries.
The representatives later appealed to the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, North Soochow Road, and were informed that the Chamber would take up the matter with the Tangpu and other political organizations.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

NEW LIFE MOVEMENT.

The New Life Movement Acceleration Association, at a meeting held at 2 p.m. yesterday, passed the following resolutions:-
1) That the Yung An Daung Tiger Medical Hall (虎標永安堂) be prohibited from using the name of new life in its advertisements.
2) That the public be warned not to misinterpret the tenets of the new life movement.

The 7th District-Tangpu Branch at Kiangwan will hold a meeting of the new life movement at 1 p.m. to-day in the premises of Tung Chi University (同濟大學).
A lantern procession will take place at 6 p.m.

China Times and other local newspapers:

TELEPHONES ON OUTSIDE ROADS

With reference to the question of telephones on extra-Settlement Roads, information secured by a reporter of the Shun Shih News Agency indicates that a meeting was held some days ago between the Chinese authorities represented by Hsu Pei Hwang, Commissioner of Public Utility, Chen Pao Chen (鄭葆成) of the Public Utility Bureau, Hsu Hsueh Yu (徐學愚) and Yuh Bing Chee (俞秉堅) of the Chinese Telephone Administration and the Shanghai Telephone Company represented by C.W.Porter, General Manager, F. Bill, and E. J. Fullam. The details of the discussions are not known, but it is understood that a proposal was submitted by the Shanghai Telephone Company for the purchase of the right to operate telephones on outside roads. As the concession would impair Chinese sovereignty, the proposal was not accepted by the Chinese delegates.
It is understood that another meeting with the representatives of the Shanghai Telephone Company will be arranged by the Chinese authorities.

1934年4月27日。晨间译文。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

本地机制冰商贩提交请愿书。

九名本地机制冰商贩代表昨日拜访了本地党部和社会局，要求采取措施遏制协成公司（Yah Chen Company）的活动。
当局官员承诺将进行查询。
随后，代表们向北苏州路的上海总商会提出呼吁，获悉商会将就此事与党部及其他政治组织进行交涉。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

新生活运动。

新生活运动促进会于昨日下午2时举行的会议上，通过以下决议：-
1) 禁止虎标永安堂在其广告中使用“新生活”名称。
2) 警告公众不要误解新生活运动的宗旨。

江湾第七区-党部支部将于今日下午1时在同济大学校舍内举行新生活运动会议。
晚上6时将举行灯笼游行。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

越界筑路上的电话

关于越界筑路（Extra-Settlement Roads）上的电话问题，顺时通讯社记者获得的消息表明，日前举行了一次会议，中方代表为公用局局长许沛黄、公用局郑葆成、中华电话管理局徐学愚和俞秉坚，上海电话公司代表为总经理 C.W.Porter、F. Bill 和 E. J. Fullam。讨论细节不详，但据悉上海电话公司提交了一项购买在越界筑路上经营电话权利的提案。由于该特许权将损害中国主权，中方代表未予接受。
据悉，中方当局将安排与上海电话公司代表再次会晤。
